translations.web: I will be yet more vile than this, and will be worthless in my own sight. But the maids of whom you have spoken will honor me.”
translations.bsb: and I will humiliate and humble myself even more than this. Yet I will be honored by the maidservants of whom you have spoken.”
translations.kjv: And I will yet be more vile than thus, and will be base in mine own sight: and of the maidservants which thou hast spoken of, of them shall I be had in honour.
